cover_headline: Air India and IndiGo Cut Europe Flights as Winter Capacity Falls 6.5% — and Foreign Carriers Take the Passengers
facts: Air India is cutting four European routes in the winter schedule, including Delhi-Vienna (ending October 31) and its Birmingham services
IndiGo suspended Delhi-Manchester and Mumbai-Manchester on August 31 and will temporarily suspend London Heathrow
India-Europe winter capacity is 5.63 million two-way seats, down 6.5% from 6.02 million a year earlier

end.headline: Air India and IndiGo Cut Europe Flights as Winter Capacity Falls 6.5% — and Foreign Carriers Take the Passengers
end.line: Air India ends Delhi-Vienna and its Birmingham services and IndiGo has suspended Manchester and will pause Heathrow, as India-Europe winter seats fall to 5.63 million.
